title: Among male patients diagnosed with SLE who have normal white blood cell cou
question: Among male patients diagnosed with SLE who have normal white blood cell counts, identify the three youngest patients based on their birthday and calculate their average age as of the year 2000. Only consider patients who have at least one laboratory test record.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(2000 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND T2."XCL_030" >= 3.5
  AND T2."XCL_030" <= 9.0
ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT AVG(2000 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060") AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T1."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
  AND T2."XCL_030" >= 3.5
  AND T2."XCL_030" <= 9.0
ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" DESC
LIMIT 3
